meta.title: Where a trace marker ends up

cards.title: Why a marker has to leave JavaScript
items: The marker is written into the kernel ring buffer, so it lands on the same timeline as scheduling and clock events rather than in a separate log
That is what lets a dropped frame be read against the CPU cluster that was running at the time, instead of guessing
The Tensor G6 TPU and GPU emit their own hardware trace events into the same buffer

cards.title: What tracing costs
items: sched costs under 0.5% and freq under 0.1%, so both can stay on for a normal profiling run
binder is the expensive one at roughly 1%, so enable it when IPC is the thing under investigation
The buffer is fixed size and overwrites, so a long capture keeps the end of the run rather than the start
